charge_state: neutral formula unit for each composition; state and magnetic treatment must be declared by the investigator
sodium_energy_convention: bulk bcc Na, with the structure and energy convention explicitly reported
voltage: For each adjacent stable hull pair x1<x2, report V=-[E(x2)-E(x1)-(x2-x1)E_Na]/[(x2-x1)e], with units and energy normalization stated
volume_change: Report 100*(V_Na4-V_Na1)/V_Na4 and the signed convention used
experimental_context: The source reports an R-3c Na2 reference and electrochemical voltage/structure comparisons; use these only as validation context, not as a substitute for computation.
author_route: The authors use enumeration, duplicate removal, periodic relaxation, formation-energy convex hull, voltage conversion and endpoint volume comparison. Choose and justify an independent implementation.
